title: AI spending stays central as markets wait for Nvidia and retail signals
source: Reuters reporting cited by U.S. News
summary: Markets are still being driven by the AI buildout theme, but investors want near-term confirmation from Nvidia and consumer-facing earnings before pushing risk higher again.
body: Testing angle: treat this as a pro-growth but not all-clear headline. It supports semiconductor, hyperscaler, and infrastructure names, but the signal is strongest when the portfolio already leans into AI capex winners. It does not remove macro rate risk.

title: Investors brace for higher Treasury yields as inflation risk stays sticky
source: Reuters reporting cited by U.S. News and Yahoo Finance
market_impact: bearish long-duration growth, supportive for financials and hedges
summary: Investors are positioning for persistently elevated yields while inflation concerns remain unresolved.
body: Testing angle: rate-sensitive growth multiples should face pressure under this scenario. Quality banks can benefit from the higher-rate backdrop, while hedges such as gold and cash buffers become more relevant.

title: Oil market outlook remains stressed by conflict and shipping disruption assumptions
source: IEA and OPEC May 2026 market reports
market_impact: bullish energy, inflationary for broader equities
summary: The oil backdrop is being shaped by supply disruption assumptions and slower demand expectations, leaving inflation-sensitive assets in focus.
body: Testing angle: energy producers can work as portfolio hedges even when broader equities struggle with inflation and rate pressure. Treat this as positive for integrated energy and mixed to negative for rate-sensitive growth.

title: Google offers policy changes in Europe to reduce antitrust pressure
source: Reuters reporting cited by The Star
summary: Alphabet is attempting to reduce European regulatory pressure with policy changes, but the headline keeps platform regulation in focus.
body: Testing angle: use this as a mild overhang rather than a thesis breaker. It adds execution and policy risk to platform stocks without immediately changing demand for AI infrastructure.

title: Britain opens a software dominance investigation into Microsoft
source: Reuters reporting cited by Channel News Asia
summary: UK regulators are investigating Microsoft's position in business software, adding another policy risk thread for mega-cap tech.
body: Testing angle: this is a manageable but negative headline for sentiment. It should reduce conviction slightly rather than force a hard exit from a structurally strong cloud and AI name.
